findings.finding: Reproduced Judge Gen's S1 (`judge-verify.md`): across all 79 tests, every rejection fixture places the broken file at `agentConfigPath`, so no test pairs a valid agent file with a rejected trusted project file (`specs/configuration/spec.md` scenario `No fallback to the other layer`, guarding Joel's Q1(b)). Mutating `src/config/taiknr-config.ts:67-70` to swallow `projectConfigPath` errors (falling back to the agent file) and mutating `:105` to skip `validateDocument` on `layer === "project"` both left `vitest run` green (`79 passed`). Production code at `HEAD` (`469abe2`) is already correct (both layers run the same `readDocument` -> `validateDocument` pipeline and every branch in `src/` is exercised; `tasks.md` 3.1/7.1 omitted this cross-product case). Route: non-blocking `minor` (to Derek only if the conductor elects to close minor test items before merge; otherwise ships as-is).
